#Packages 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)   
library(ggrepel)    
library(scales)      
library(cowplot)
library(readxl)
```

# Folder for figures
```{r}

dir.create("fig", showWarnings = FALSE)

```


# Open data

```{r}

# Filtering out 2024 and 2025 for which we have only data for bild and (2024) Monde diplo

soccat_broad <- readr::read_delim(
  "category_summary_outlet_year_final.csv",
  delim = ";",
  na = c("", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  select(-matches("^202[45]_(N|pct)$"))

glimpse(soccat_broad)

soccat_categories <- readr::read_delim(
  "label_summary_outlet_year_final.csv",
  delim = ";",
  na = c("", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  select(-matches("^202[45]_(N|pct)$"))

glimpse(soccat_categories)


```


# Reshape to long format

```{r}

soccat_broad_long <- soccat_broad %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}_(N|pct)$") & !matches("^202[45]_(N|pct)$"),
    names_to = c("year", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(\\d{4})_(N|pct)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    category = str_replace_all(category, "_", " ")
  )

soccat_categories_long <- soccat_categories %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}_(N|pct)$") & !matches("^202[45]_(N|pct)$"),
    names_to = c("year", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(\\d{4})_(N|pct)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    label = str_replace_all(label, "_", " ")
  )


```


# Labels for countries and ideological orientation

```{r}

soccat_broad_long <- soccat_broad_long %>%
  mutate(
    country_group = case_when(
      outlet %in% c("figaro", "lemonde", "liberation", "mediapart", "mondediplo") ~ "French",
      outlet %in% c("bild", "faz", "spiegel", "sz", "welt", "zeit") ~ "German",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ideology_group = case_when(
      outlet %in% c("liberation", "mediapart", "mondediplo", "sz") ~ "Left-wing",
      outlet %in% c("lemonde", "spiegel", "zeit") ~ "Centrist",
      outlet %in% c("figaro", "faz", "welt") ~ "Conservative",
      outlet %in% c("bild") ~ "Populist right-wing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

soccat_categories_long <- soccat_categories_long %>%
  mutate(
    country_group = case_when(
      outlet %in% c("figaro", "lemonde", "liberation", "mediapart", "mondediplo") ~ "French",
      outlet %in% c("bild", "faz", "spiegel", "sz", "welt", "zeit") ~ "German",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ideology_group = case_when(
      outlet %in% c("liberation", "mediapart", "mondediplo", "sz") ~ "Left-wing",
      outlet %in% c("lemonde", "spiegel", "zeit") ~ "Centrist",
      outlet %in% c("figaro", "faz", "welt") ~ "Conservative",
      outlet %in% c("bild") ~ "Populist right-wing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```


# Distribution broad classes

```{r}
category_country_summary <- soccat_broad_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct), !is.na(country_group), year <= 2023) %>%
  group_by(category, country_group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_pct = median(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(pct, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(pct, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_pct = IQR(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ordre commun des catégories
category_order <- category_country_summary %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(overall_median = mean(median_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(overall_median) %>%
  pull(category)

category_country_summary <- category_country_summary %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order),
    country_group = factor(country_group, levels = c("French", "German"))
  )

p_category_country_compare <- ggplot(
  category_country_summary,
  aes(x = median_pct, y = category, color = country_group)
) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = q25, xmax = q75),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("French" = "#F8766D", "German" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Median share of sentences",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    title = "Salience of broad categories in French and German outlets",
    subtitle = "Median and interquartile range"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35")
  )

p_category_country_compare

ggsave(
  filename = "fig/broad_categories_france_germany_median_iqr.png",
  plot = p_category_country_compare,
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```



# Distribution social categories

```{r}

#ordre vertical des labels est basé sur la moyenne des médianes France/Allemagne

top20_common_labels <- soccat_categories_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct), !is.na(country_group), year <= 2023) %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    median_pct_all = median(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_pct_all)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(label)

country_summary <- soccat_categories_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pct),
    !is.na(country_group),
    year <= 2023,
    label %in% top20_common_labels
  ) %>%
  group_by(country_group, label) %>%
  summarise(
    median_pct = median(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(pct, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(pct, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

label_order <- country_summary %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_median = mean(median_pct),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(overall_median) %>%
  pull(label)

country_summary <- country_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = label_order),
    country_group = factor(country_group, levels = c("French", "German"))
  )

p_country_compare <- ggplot(
  country_summary,
  aes(x = median_pct, y = label, color = country_group)
) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = q25, xmax = q75),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("French" = "#F8766D", "German" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Median share of sentences",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    title = "Salience of social labels in French and German outlets",
    subtitle = "Median and interquartile range, top 20 labels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35")
  )

p_country_compare

ggsave(
  filename = "fig/compare_country_medians_iqr_top20.png",
  plot = p_country_compare,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)


```


## Focus on single groups

```{r}

# Labels of interest
labels_focus <- c(
  "people with an immigration background including immigrants",
  "muslims",
  "patients",
  "health and care professionals"
)

# Optional check
setdiff(labels_focus, unique(soccat_categories_long$label))

# Average yearly salience by country group
label_country_avg_focus <- soccat_categories_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pct),
    year <= 2023,
    !is.na(country_group),
    label %in% labels_focus
  ) %>%
  group_by(label, country_group, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    country_group = factor(country_group, levels = c("French", "German")),
    label = factor(label, levels = labels_focus)
  )

# Events to annotate
annotation_base <- tibble::tribble(
  ~label, ~year, ~event,
  "patients", 2020, "covid outbreak",
  "health and care professionals", 2020, "covid outbreak",
  "people with an immigration background including immigrants", 2015, "refugee crisis",
  "people with an immigration background including immigrants", 2010, "Sarrazin debate in Germany",
  "muslims", 2015, "refugee crisis",
  "muslims", 2004, "veil ban in France",
  "muslims", 2010, "Sarrazin debate in Germany"
)

# Attach each event to the higher line in the corresponding facet-year
annotation_df <- annotation_base %>%
  left_join(
    label_country_avg_focus %>%
      group_by(label, year) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = mean_pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup(),
    by = c("label", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = labels_focus),
    country_group = factor(country_group, levels = c("French", "German"))
  )

# Plot
p_focus_country_trends <- ggplot(
  label_country_avg_focus,
  aes(x = year, y = mean_pct, color = country_group, group = country_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(
    data = annotation_df,
    aes(xintercept = year),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = annotation_df,
    aes(x = year, y = mean_pct, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    seed = 123,
    size = 3.1,
    label.size = 0.2,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey20",
    segment.color = "grey45",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.8,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1995, 2023, by = 5),
    limits = c(1995, 2025),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.06))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01, suffix = "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("French" = "#F8766D", "German" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average share of sentences",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Long-term salience trends in French and German newspapers"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_focus_country_trends


ggsave(
  filename = "fig/single_groups_labelled_france_germany.png",
  plot = p_focus_country_trends,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```
